name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1483: REG-079 was not really about two stale assertions; it was that nothing was watching them. The gate set used to be a list people carried in their heads, so it differed per person and per session and a suite could fall out of it in silence. tv/run_gates.py is now that list in a file with one verdict, and TestNoOrphanSuite fails if a tv/test_star.py exists that the runner does not name, plus the reverse (a gate pointing at a deleted file) and a rule that every gate must say what it protects. Running it immediately found two more failures. test_roundtrip_sim had been unrunnable whenever the app was open, because the Windows single-primary mutex used one machine-wide name rather than scoping by control port - a broader claim than the problem it solved, since a process on another port is a different instance and that is exactly what a harness is. The mutex is now per-port, so the desktop icon still cannot spawn two primaries on 17772 while an isolated harness runs alongside. The same suite also leaked its control_app child (kill without wait), which kept a port held and made the next run fail to bind; it now terminates, escalates and always reaps.
